setup: Persistent application configuration lives in /kavita/config. Add explicit media mounts before creating libraries.
Automatic app setup creates the first administrator with a username, password and email, then checks that an administrator exists.
integration_notes: Timezone is available as a typed environment setting. The health action checks the running API.
Library scanning, readers, users and server preferences remain available in Kavita.
limitations: This recipe uses the available 0.9.1 container image tag. Patch release names do not necessarily correspond to Docker image tags.
Kavita runtime settings, OIDC and library creation are not automated by this profile.
